facts.fact: The mobile number can be updated at an Aadhaar Enrolment Centre or through the postman, with no document or old mobile number needed
facts.quote: You can update your mobile number in Aadhaar by visiting any of the Aadhaar Enrolment Centre or through postman, for which no document or old mobile number is required.

facts.fact: India Post Payments Bank's doorstep banking service lists 'Mobile number update in AADHAAR'
facts.quote: Third-party Services Life Insurance General Insurance Mutual Funds Financial Services Mobile number update in AADHAAR Digital Life Certificate Generation

facts.fact: The Aadhaar app also offers Mobile Number Update
facts.quote: Presently, the Aadhaar app offers various services like - Mobile Number Update, Address Update, Biometric lock/unlock, Selective Sharing of Aadhaar Verifiable Credential, check Authentication History, download e-Aadhaar, share Contact Card, Track my request, etc.

facts.fact: The official fee for a mobile number update done separately is Rs 75
facts.quote: (2) Demographic update: Update of enrolled name, gender, date of birth, address, mobile number or email address, or any combination of the same (i) If done at the same time with biometric update: Free (ii) If done separately: ₹75

facts.fact: UIDAI's official centre locator is the Bhuvan Aadhaar portal
facts.quote: You can update your mobile number by visiting any Aadhaar Enrolment centre. Aadhaar Enrolment centre can be located by visiting at Bhuvan portal: https://bhuvan-app3.nrsc.gov.in/aadhaar/

summary: Turn facts confirmed on UIDAI pages: centre/postman (IPPB doorstep)/Aadhaar app channels, no document or old number, Rs 75 fee, Bhuvan Aadhaar locator.
